description: Turn agent JSON into styled, self-contained widget HTML (POST /v1/ui/render). Real server-side HTML/SVG generation, stdlib only, no external requests.
name: ui_render
provider_notes: No external provider. HTML/CSS/SVG generated locally; rendered page stored in ctx.memory (aul:ui_render:{render_id}). CDN embed URL is a labeled placeholder until deploy. Demo runs against an in-memory FakeCtx, clearly labeled.
